neighbours.label: Low-confidence guess: ' so' introducing a consequence after a comma ('Most polymers are incompatible, so they separate'); the same sentences without the consequence clause stay quiet.
fire: Oil and water do not mix, so they form layers.
The bridge was closed, so we took the ferry.
The paint was still wet, so nobody sat down.
The metal expands when hot, so the rails have gaps.
The shop was out of bread, so we baked our own.
The soil is acidic, so blueberries grow well.
The battery was flat, so the car would not start.
The ice was thin, so skating was banned.
quiet: Oil and water have different densities.
The bridge was closed for repairs.
The paint was still wet this morning.
The metal expands when it gets hot.
The shop was out of bread by noon.
The soil here is acidic and dark.
The battery was flat after the winter.
The ice on the pond was thin.

notes: Card: ' if' x6, ' so' x4, ' when' x3, ' onset' x2 (incompatible with one another,⟦ so⟧ tend to produce separate phases). Exploratory probe weak: ', so they separate' 0.24, 'onset of symptoms' 0.12.
